x-e-m1-01.title: Je, Ben atakuja kwenye sherehe? Kuchunguza maana iliyofichika ya majibu yake
x-e-m1-01.goal: Gawanya majibu ya Ben katika mazungumzo mstari kwa mstari, tenganisha kilichoamuliwa na kinachobaki, na utoe hukumu bila kudai 'atakuja' au 'hatakuja.'

Mazungumzo kati ya Jisu na Ben (yameandikwa kama maandishi tu, bila picha):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.

x-e-m1-01.s.s2.model.0: Mchezo wa soccer ni asubuhi na sherehe ni saa 4 p.m., kwa hiyo saa haziingiliani. Lakini Ben alisema 'Let me check with my mom first.', kwa hiyo ruhusa ya mama yake inabaki, na nilihukumu kwamba bado hatujui.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.model.1: 'That might work' inamaanisha inawezekana, na mchezo wa asubuhi na sherehe ya saa 4 p.m. haziingiliani. Kuchoka ni wasiwasi tu, na kwa kuwa alisema mwishoni atamuuliza mama yake, uamuzi unategemea jibu la mama yake.
